title: Sopra Steria Netherlands has the best NL framework access and the weakest partnership fit
content:
The Dutch arm of Sopra Steria is credited with the best framework access in the Netherlands and, in the same sentence, the weakest partnership fit in the set. Its recorded stack is Microsoft and Salesforce — proprietary alliances with no open-source anchor — and it sits at priority 9.

The two halves of that verdict are not independent. The reason a firm accumulates framework positions is that it has been an accepted large-scale supplier for years, and that same history is what builds deep alliances with the platform vendors government buyers already procure. The credentials that create access are the credentials that fill the slot.

This is why the screen ranks partnership fit above route-to-market. An inaccessible good partner can be helped into a framework, or reached through one that already has a position; a well-positioned firm with no reason to carry your layer cannot be argued into wanting it. Kainos shows the same inversion in the UK with evidenced framework coverage and Workday anchoring, and the UK Sopra Steria entity records it in almost identical words.
